name: Eleven
description:
About This Game

🔹 Over 100 Million Ways To Customize Your Ship

Stand out in the void with a ship that matches your identity. ELEVEN lets you customize your thrusters, shields, ship body, laser style, and more. Go bold with neon glows, or keep it sleek with stealthy finishes.

While combat is purely competitive, expression is limitless. You earn respect through performance — but you earn style through choice.

🔹 Enjoy Fast Paced Head-to-Head Combat

The arenas in ELEVEN aren't just maps — they’re dynamic battlegrounds set in the depths of space. Navigate vertical zones, tight corridors, and wide-open kill boxes, all suspended in zero gravity.

Each arena is built for high-mobility, low-latency combat where the only limit is your reaction time. Master the layout, control the angles, and dominate the arena from every axis.

🔹 Cross-Platform For The Whole Family

Whether you're on PC or console, ELEVEN keeps everyone in the same arena. Jump into seamless matchmaking across platforms and compete with friends — or enemies — no matter where they play. The controls are tight, the performance is sharp, and the action is balanced for fair, skill-first fights across every device.

No matter how you play, you're always in the fight.
short_desc: In Eleven, customize your ship with powerful lasers, adaptive shields, and precision thrusters. Choose colors, ships, and thrusters to match your style. Master zero-gravity mechanics and outmaneuver rivals in intense space battles where every choice matters.
